system.description:
The sky turns a smoky red and streams of fire erupt on the wind, annihilating the wizard’s enemies. Damaging effect spell: Power = Will +2, VA 5. Die of Fate to determine IMS. Weapon Length: as Missile; Range: as Heavy Crossbow +1D.

Obstacle: 5^. Actions: 7.

Origin: Sight | Area of Effect: 10s of Paces | Element: Fire/Air | Impetus: Destroy | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 20

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 218
